label: A mover whose being another causes is in POTENCY_1 to its operation whenever it moves
paraphrase: OPEN analyst formulation, attribution deferred: whenever a being y, whose being some other thing causes (some c distinct from y with CausesIn c y esse), moves x in respect r, that moving is an operation of y in a respect o of its own in which y is in potency (adopted POTENCY_1: able to be so and not actually so). The non-God-indexed restatement of f03798ba-e9d8-5594-b354-81fb9e9048c0: its domain is every caused mover, so it implies that statement for each God-bearer that causes y's being. Under POTENCY_1 it commits that the agent is not in act in o while it moves; it fits successive operations (a mover still acquiring o, such as a driven stick still moving through place) and is false of any caused mover that is already in act in every operation respect of its moving (steady exercise of a retained power), if there is one. Lean binding (not yet registered): the MotionMapsBatch1 vocabulary with OperationOf and AdoptedPotency.InPotency, the domain guard being (exists c, c ≠ y and CausesIn c y esse); see docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md.
